data.name: STICKMAN DX : MEGA FIGHTERS
data.detailed_description:
STICKMAN DX: MEGA FIGHTERS

Get ready for an explosive experience blending fighting game and third-person shooter. These 2 combined game styles create unique gameplay offering innovative combat technique possibilities.

🔸 Dynamic and varied gameplay: Switch between punch combos, uppercuts, special attacks, dodges, super sprints, transformations, super attacks, ground traps, shields, teleportations, clone summons, grabs, combat style changes, and much more! All supported by fluid and intuitive gameplay!

🔸 Evolving and hostile arenas: Survive as long as possible and eject your enemies in fully destructible arenas where difficulty increases every minute. (The longer you last, the more numerous and dangerous enemies become)

🔸 Colossal bosses: Face titanic bosses in epic battles where every hit counts.

🔸 Unique stickman aesthetic: A fast-paced and original visual style, a tribute to the cult world of Stickmans, for total immersion.

💥 Will you be fast enough, strong enough, and tactical enough to become the ultimate Super Fighter?

STICKMAN DX: MEGA FIGHTERS awaits you. Get ready!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3450 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 (2GB) / AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 3770 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (3GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
